name: cortex
description: Permanent, decentralized memory layer for AI agents. Write, recall, and query verifiable memory objects anchored on X Layer and stored permanently via Arweave.
registration_endpoint: https://<your-deployed-domain>/mcp — this is what you give OKX.AI during A2MCP registration, confirmed via web3.okx.com/onchainos/dev-docs/okxai/howtomcp.md. Requires public HTTPS; Railway's default *.up.railway.app domain satisfies this with no extra setup.
not_the_registration_endpoint: server/index.js's plain REST routes (/memory/write etc.) are for direct HTTP/x402 callers, not A2MCP. mcp/server.js (stdio) is local-only, for testing with Claude Code/Cursor — the internet can't reach it.

tools.name: write_memory
tools.description: Permanently store a structured memory object (event, decision, outcome, preference, or conversation summary) for an agent. Returns a content-addressed id and an on-chain anchor proof.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Retrieve a previously written memory object by id, with on-chain verification that it hasn't been tampered with.

tools.name: query_memory
tools.description: Query an agent's memory history, optionally filtered by type (event, decision, outcome, preference, conversation).

note: Registration is conversational, not a static form (confirmed via web3.okx.com/onchainos/dev-docs/okxai/registerasp.md): install Onchain OS Skills (`npx skills add okx/onchainos-skills --yes -g`), log in to Agentic Wallet, then prompt your agent 'Help me register an A2MCP ASP on OKX.AI using Onchain OS' and supply service name, description, price per call, and the /mcp endpoint URL above. Test the /mcp endpoint first with the official MCP Inspector (`npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector`) before registering. Payment billing for A2MCP calls is handled by OKX.AI itself once listed — separate from the x402 gate on the plain REST routes. Review takes up to 2 business days.
